title: Jar with flowers
summary: Metepec, in central Mexico, is known for everyday clay ware and for bright, hand-modelled clay. Flowers, leaves and small balls are pressed onto the wall of a jar, then fired and painted in strong colours. Here you throw a jar with a wide mouth and choose the colour of each band.
howToPlay: Look at the lit jar in its painted frame: it shows the shape and the colour of each band.
Drag across the clay to set how wide each row is.
Press Glaze, then tap a band and a colour: turquoise, marigold or magenta.
Press Check to see your stars, or Watch and learn to see a round played for you.
rules: Shape counts for 70 percent of the score: the closer each of the 12 rows is to the width of the lit target, the better.
Finish counts for 30 percent: a band scores when it carries the same swatch as the target.
The applied flowers are part of the picture; the colour of the band is what you set.
Undo takes back one stroke; Reshape goes back to the clay; Reset starts the shape again.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
heritageNote: Metepec lies close to Toluca in central Mexico. Potters there make plain household ware as well as modelled pieces, which are shaped by hand or in moulds, fired, and painted in bright colours.
